findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, stock_token_check, roast_token · Private data: scan_token, can_i_sell, colony_activity, swoge_economy, new_launches, wallet_intel, chat_completion, robinhood_token, robinhood_wallet, token_verdict, stock_token_check, stock_tokens_premium, base_launches, base_deployer, fair_commit, roast_token, ask_agent, generate_image, generate_video, pay_service, payment_audit · Public sink: can_i_sell, colony_activity, swoge_economy, base_deployer, fair_commit, roast_token, generate_image, find_esim_plans, search_x402_services, pay_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, stock_token_check, roast_token · Private data: scan_token, can_i_sell, colony_activity, swoge_economy, new_launches, wallet_intel, chat_completion, robinhood_token, robinhood_wallet, token_verdict, stock_token_check, stock_tokens_premium, base_launches, base_deployer, fair_commit, roast_token, ask_agent, generate_image, generate_video, pay_service, payment_audit · Public sink: can_i_sell, colony_activity, swoge_economy, base_deployer, fair_commit, roast_token, generate_image, find_esim_plans, search_x402_services, pay_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
